lines: There was a small elderly man tottering down the early-afternoon mountain road.
「Hyo hyo hyo. My, it's been a long time since I was in these parts.」
At first glance, his was merely the figure of a shrivelled old man.
But that was impossible. This was a dangerous area where Gosha, the Taimanin village, bordered with the outside world, and one couldn't let one's guard down.
By no means was it a place where a helpless old man could stroll along on his own.
A gust of wind had passed through.
After which, there was a man clad in ninja attire kneeling there in front of the elderly man, whom he had called “Your Lordship”.
「The “fox” has been cornered in a hole. We did try to smoke it out just by ourselves once, but――」
「Hyo hyo♪ And you got bitten? Well, that fox woman is a bit of a heavy load for inexperienced youngsters like you.」
「......As you say. Now, we have stretched our net around the hole, and are awaiting the arrival of Your Lordship and the main force.」
「That will do. Hunting is something to be enjoyed at one's leisure, after all――」
However, the face of the ninja receiving his orders had stiffened firmly, and a terrified sweat was covering his back.
As if he feared incurring the old man's displeasure, even a tiny bit.
「Also, there is one more thing. Something that bothers me.」
「According to our scouts, it seems there was the presence of someone in the hole other than the fox.」
The old man cocked his head curiously, and soon gave a broad smile as though he had realized something.
「Hyo hyo hyo! Well, fine. Anyhow, the prey is wounded. Don't panic. Take your time cornering her.」
The ninja bowed his head deeply at the old man's feet.
Some Taimanin guarding the Gosha border pointed their blades at the strange old man and the ninja.
